# AgentOre v0.0.5

AgentOre v0.0.5 changes the default Base Mainnet RPC to PublicNode for more reliable menu-bar chain data.

## Included

- `https://base-rpc.publicnode.com` as the default Base Mainnet RPC;
- automatic migration from the previous `https://mainnet.base.org` default;
- preservation of custom RPC endpoints and explicit automatic-submission preferences.

## Install

1. Download `AgentOre-v0.0.5-macos-universal.zip` and its `.sha256` file.
2. Verify the SHA-256 checksum.
3. Unzip and move `AgentOre.app` to `/Applications`.

The app requires macOS 14 or newer. This release is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized.

AgentOre usage values remain self-reported. The deployed contract has not been professionally audited and is not suitable for assets with monetary value.
